title: docs(pm-dispatch): a PR that spends a shared budget merges main first at any K
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi977dbpdY6XSEECpgK8uynUu)_

Fixes #34203

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:落地规则的 K 条款加一类「任何 K 都先合 main」:PR 耗共享预算(skills token 棘轮、ui 英文语种块体积上限),而 PRBASE 后 main 已动同一本账。
- 为什么改:上周队列复盘里,两个过期基座根因是共享预算账本,K 小于 15 没触发刷新,两个各自绿的 PR 叠在一起把队列打红。
- 风险与回滚:只改席位读的规则文本 4 行,不动门禁、上限与队列设置;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` 的 K 块(第 43–46 行)与删去的第 3 行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期两条都绿,文件仍 112/112 行。
- 需要你做的:Tier S,契约复审 PASS 后由席位落地;你无需操作。

## What changes

`landing-operations.md`, the K block only (lines 43–46 after the edit), plus one payer.

Before (one any-K clause):

> - K ≥ 15,或标签 PR 的 PRBASE 后 main 落新语种包(任何 K)⇒ 先 merge main 等重跑绿,`behind` 例外。

After (folded; the label-definition line is kept verbatim below it):

> - K ≥ 15 ⇒ 先 merge main 等重跑绿,`behind` 例外;任何 K 同:标签 PR 的 PRBASE 后 main 落新语种包;
> - 或共享预算 PR 遇 `git diff --name-only PRBASE..origin/main` 碰同本输入或账本;封闭两本,输入:账本:
> - `skills/**`:`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`;`ui/**/locales/en.ts`:`ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`

- Ask 1 (widen, closed list): the any-K refresh now covers a PR that spends a shared budget, with exactly two budgets named. The locale clause is folded into the same sentence, not duplicated. The K threshold (15), the PRBASE definition and the `behind` exception are unchanged.
- Ask 2 (cheap reading): "main moved that budget" = `git diff --name-only PRBASE..origin/main` lists the budget's input glob or its ledger file. Inputs measured on main `31eb2aed`:
  - published-skills token ratchet: input `skills/**` (the gate walks the published skill directories under `skills/`), ledger `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.
  - `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS`: its only locale or strings key is `i18n-locale-en`. `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` routes exactly one module into that chunk (`/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts$/`), and `en.ts` has no imports. `git ls-files 'ui/**/locales/en.ts'` matches exactly `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`. The ledger is `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, which holds the constant.
- A PR "spends" a budget when its own diff touches that input. The rule reads that from "同本输入".

### Line budget (headroom 0, paid in-file)

`landing-operations.md` is 112 → 112 lines. The ceiling is not moved. Every line is ≤ 120 bytes (`LC_ALL=C awk 'length($0)>120'` prints nothing). The K block went from 2 to 4 lines (+2), because the content floor is about 400 bytes: two label-gate names, two input globs, two ledger paths and the `git diff` reading. Two lines pay for it, and the seat ruled both:

1. Deleted old line 3 「执行席在落地窗口(ACCEPT 之后至 MERGED)读本文;入队与落地条款与 A–D 操作细则都在此。」. Its surviving home is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:95`, the stage-file index row `` `references/landing-operations.md` | 执行席落地窗口(ACCEPT 之后至 MERGED) | 入队与落地 · A–D 操作细则 ``. Same reader (the execution seat), same window, same contents, same direction.
2. Deleted old line 2, the blank line that separated that paragraph. Once line 3 was gone, two blank lines stood back to back. This is the deleted paragraph's own separator leaving with it. **It is not a rule line and not a re-wrap**, and it buys no room anywhere else. It is listed separately so review#2 can judge it.

Candidates I looked at and rejected (left untouched):
- Line 7. It looks like `SKILL.md:191-192`, but `execution-duties.md:76` names 「条款②入队闸门」, so deleting it would orphan that name.
- Lines 92–94. `SKILL.md:34` covers them only in part: it has no 标准认领行 and no 分诊不成车道.
- Line 87. It resembles `triage-duties.md:28`, but that line has a different reader (the triage seat).

`lanes/queue.md` does not restate the K rule. `execution-duties.md:37` only points at 「落地 K」. No second file changed.

## Tests

Text-only change to a `.claude/**` reference. No code and no tests. Ablation does not apply (os-dev.md: docs are not ablated).

## Acceptance notes

### Proof: replay of #31518 re-reading rows 10, 11 and 60 (comment 6904236520)

How I measured: local git on a checkout deepened to `--shallow-since=2026-11-05`, with every PRBASE on main. I fetched each merge-group commit by sha (`git fetch origin SHA`). Each one has a single parent, the queue base. The PR's own spend is `git diff --name-only PARENT ENTRY`. "Main moved" is `git diff --name-only PRBASE..M`, where M is the main commit at the re-reading's enqueue K (first-parent count from PRBASE). The rows' PRBASE values come from the re-reading table. The script is at the end of this section.

| row | PR | PRBASE | PR spends (input touched) | main moved since PRBASE (at the enqueue base) | K at enqueue | old rule | new clause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | #32050 | `0f7389cc` | `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` (+10 other locale files) | `en.ts` via `cc8c4b0f4` (#32129, 10:40Z, K 4) and `d8d07910b` (#32028, 11:13Z); at K 11 (`8523ef9ac`) the diff already lists `en.ts` | 11 (re-reading: 11+6 queued) | **missed**: K < 15, and no new locale pack (`--diff-filter=A` on `locales/` = 0) | **caught** |
| 11 | #32050 (same queue stay, head unchanged) | `0f7389cc` | same | same, plus K 15 at queue parent `dee2e920` | 15 | caught by K ≥ 15 (at the rebuild) | **caught**: the clause fires before row 10's enqueue, so this rebuild never happens |
| 60 | #33355 | `82838e83` | `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 23 `skills/**` paths, first `3968a57d5` (#33427, 11-14 21:26Z), then #33555, #33726 and others | 227 | caught by K ≥ 15, **if a seat enqueues** (a maintainer enqueued it by hand) | **caught, if a seat enqueues**: same caveat; the rule binds seats only |

Net: the new clause catches all three. Only row 10 is a catch that K ≥ 15 alone missed. Row 11 follows from row 10. Row 60 was already inside K ≥ 15, and neither rule binds a hand enqueue. No row is NOT MEASURED.

<details><summary>Replay script and raw output</summary>

```sh
# replay ROW PRBASE ENTRY CREATED REGEX
parent=$(git rev-parse $ENTRY^)
git diff --name-only $parent $ENTRY | grep -Ec "$REGEX"                                   # PR spend
M=$(git rev-list --first-parent --reverse $PRBASE..origin/main | sed -n "${K}p")       # main at enqueue K
git diff --name-only $PRBASE..$M | grep -E "$REGEX"                                      # main moved
# UI='^ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/|^ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget\.mjs$'
# SK='^skills/|^scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet\.mjs$'
```

- row 10: entry `7b675fd9` parent `c4383e86` (queued #32034 on top of #32028's queue twin). PR spend 11 locale paths. At K 11 (`8523ef9ac`), main moved 11 locale paths incl. `en.ts`. Added locale files 0.
- row 11: entry `25652525` parent `dee2e920`. First-parent K from PRBASE is 15. main moved: the same 11 paths.
- row 60: entry `222ad788` parent `346d56d4`. First-parent K is 227. PR spend 1 path. main moved 23 `skills/**` paths across 8+ landings.

</details>

### Out of scope

None filed. Not changed by this PR: the gates, the ceilings and the merge-queue settings.
